proof_body:
by
  intro K V _ _ _ _ f n μ v hn hμ hv
  have li : LinearIndependent K v := Module.End.eigenvectors_linearIndependent' f μ hμ v hv
  have hs : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span K (Set.range v) :=
    (li.span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank' (by simp [hn])).ge
  refine ⟨Module.Basis.mk li hs, fun i => ?_⟩
  rw [Module.Basis.mk_apply]
  exact (hv i).apply_eq_smul
target_source: ∀ (K V : Type*) [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] (f : Module.End K V) (n : ℕ) (μ : Fin n → K) (v : Fin n → V), Module.finrank K V = n → Function.Injective μ → (∀ i, Module.End.HasEigenvector f (μ i) (v i)) → ∃ b : Module.Basis (Fin n) K V, ∀ i, f (b i) = μ i • b i
